📺 Masters of Sex (2013–2016)

Masters of Sex follows Dr. William Masters, a respected physician, and Virginia Johnson, his ambitious research assistant, as they challenge society’s understanding of human sexuality during the 1950s and 1960s. Working together at Washington University in St. Louis, the pair conduct groundbreaking scientific research while facing criticism, professional obstacles, and complicated personal relationships. As their controversial studies gain attention, their partnership develops into an increasingly complex connection that affects their careers, marriages, and personal lives. Starring Michael Sheen and Lizzy Caplan, the series combines historical drama, romance, and emotional storytelling while exploring ambition, relationships, scientific discovery, and changing social attitudes.

🎭 Genre: Drama • Romance • Biography

⭐ IMDb: 7.9/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 55–60 minutes per episode • TV-MA

🎥 Creator: Michelle Ashford

📚 Based On: Masters of Sex by Thomas Maier

🏆 Awards: Allison Janney won a Primetime Emmy Award for her performance.

📺 Where to Watch: Check Paramount+ with SHOWTIME and digital platforms for current availability in the United States.
